text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Prevention of Pollution of the Sea (Compoundable Offences) Regulations, 2008. Compoundable offences.

( 1) Any of the offences specified in the Schedule may be compounded for a sum not exceeding $2,000.

(2) The offence punishable under section 22(5) of the Order may be compounded for a sum not exceeding $500. SCHEDULE (regulation 2(1))

COMPOUNDABLE OFFENCES
Regulation 9 of the Prevention of Pollution of the Sea (Noxious Liquid Substances in Bulk) Regulations, 2008.

Regulation 14 of the Prevention of Pollution of the Sea (Garbage) Regulations, Made this 13th. day of Zulhijjah, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 11th. day of December, 2008.

PERIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA DR. HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Communications, Brunei Darussalam.
